name: help-command
description: Test that geode help command works
stderr:
geode - Property graph database implementing ISO/IEC 39075:2024 (GQL)

Usage: geode [options] <subcommand> [args...]

Global Options:
  -h, --help          Show help
  -v, --verbose       Verbose output
  --config <path>     Configuration file path
  --json              Force JSON output for all subcommands
  --audit             Enable audit logging
  --audit-syslog <host:port>  Syslog server for audit logs
  --audit-file <path> File path for audit logs
  --audit-eventlog [source]   Enable Windows Event Log (default source: Geode)

Subcommands:
  serve               Start the database server
  shell               Interactive GQL shell
  query               Execute a GQL query
  backup              Create database backup
  restore             Restore database from backup
  migrate             Run database migrations
  auth                Authentication commands
  user                User management
  role                Role management
  policy              RLS policy management
  grant               Grant permissions
  revoke              Revoke permissions

Examples:
  geode serve --data-dir ./data --listen 0.0.0.0:8443
  geode query "MATCH (n) RETURN n LIMIT 10"
  geode user create alice alice@example.com
  geode shell --server localhost:8443

Use 'geode <subcommand> --help' for more information on a specific command.

name: serve-help
description: Test that geode serve help works
stderr:
geode serve - Start the database server

Usage: geode serve [options]

Options:
  --data-dir <path>      Data directory (default: ./data)
  --listen <addr:port>   Listen address (default: 0.0.0.0:8443)
  --cert <path>          TLS certificate path (auto-generated if missing)
  --key <path>           TLS private key path (auto-generated if missing)
  --log-level <level>    Log level: debug|info|warn|error (default: info)
  --stdio                Use stdio for communication (development mode)
  -h, --help             Show this help

Examples:
  geode serve
  geode serve --data-dir /var/lib/geode --listen 0.0.0.0:8443
  geode serve --stdio --log-level debug

name: query-help
description: Test that geode query help works
stderr:
geode query - Execute a GQL query

Usage: geode query [options] <query>

Options:
  --server <addr:port>   Server address (default: 127.0.0.1:8443)
  --format <fmt>         Output format: json|table|csv (default: json)
  --json-param <name> <value>  Add JSON parameter
  --page-size <n>        Page size for results (default: 1000)
  --begin                Start transaction
  --commit               Commit transaction
  --rollback             Rollback transaction
  -h, --help             Show this help

Examples:
  geode query "MATCH (n) RETURN n LIMIT 10"
  geode query --format table "MATCH (u:User) RETURN u.name, u.email"
  geode query --json-param id 123 "MATCH (n) WHERE id(n) = $id RETURN n"
